# InstaBox

> A Linux machine of its own in the cloud for every agent.

- [InstaBox](https://instabox.sh/docs/index.md): A Linux machine of its own in the cloud for every agent.
- [Quick start](https://instabox.sh/docs/quickstart.md): Install the CLI and start your first machine.
- [MCP](https://instabox.sh/docs/integrations/mcp.md): Machine tools for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Antigravity, and a public server that reads these docs.
- [Concepts](https://instabox.sh/docs/concepts.md): The few words the dashboard, the CLI and the API use.
- [Use cases](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/index.md): Step-by-step guides for what people build on InstaBox, from running a model's code to CI.
- [Run AI-generated code](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/run-ai-code.md): Give a model a machine to run the code it writes, and send the output back to it.
- [Coding agents](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/coding-agents.md): Give Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode a Linux machine of its own to work on your repo, with the provider key kept out of the machine.
- [ADEs](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/ade/index.md): Connect a desktop app for coding agents to a machine, so its agents work there and not on your laptop.
- [cmux](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/ade/cmux.md): Open a cmux workspace on an instabox machine from one link.
- [Orca](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/ade/orca.md): Run each Orca workspace on its own instabox machine.
- [Paradev](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/ade/paradev.md): Add an instabox machine as a Paradev host, so its agents run there.
- [T3 Code](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/ade/t3-code.md): Pair T3 Code with an instabox machine, so its agents run there.
- [Parallel forks](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/parallel-forks.md): Set up one machine, copy it into several, try a different approach in each copy, and keep the one that works best.
- [Computer use](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/computer-use.md): Have a model drive a browser on a machine's desktop while you watch it live or share a link.
- [Preview URLs](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/preview-urls.md): Run your app's dev server in a machine and give a reviewer, a phone, or a webhook sender an HTTPS link to it.
- [CI](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/ci.md): Run your GitHub Actions jobs on fresh machines, or run one test command on InstaBox from any CI.
- [Android apps](https://instabox.sh/docs/use-cases/android.md): Run your app on Android 14 in a machine, drive it with adb, and watch the phone in the dashboard.
- [Lifecycle](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/lifecycle.md): Start, pause, resume, stop, restart, restore and delete a machine.
- [Run commands](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/run-commands.md): Run a command in a machine, stream its output, and keep long jobs running in the background.
- [Files](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/files.md): Copy files and folders between your computer and a machine, and read or write a single file.
- [Templates](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/templates.md): What a new machine starts from, how to list the templates, and how to pick one.
- [Webhooks](https://instabox.sh/docs/integrations/webhooks.md): Signed POSTs when a machine is ready, pauses, stops, fails or is deleted.
- [Sizes and create options](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/sizes.md): Pick a machine's vCPUs and memory, a template version, and every other field create takes.
- [macOS machines](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/macos.md): Create a macOS machine on a Mac leased to your workspace, on the Pro plan and higher.
- [Auto-pause and max-run](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/auto-pause.md): When a machine pauses by itself, what wakes it, and the cooldown after a maximum runtime.
- [Environment variables](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/environment.md): Plain variables for every shell in a machine, and where secrets go instead.
- [Storage and retention](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/storage.md): How long a machine and its snapshots are kept, archive and delete deadlines, and storage sync.
- [Logs and labels](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/logs-and-labels.md): Read a machine's console log and recent operations, and tag machines with key=value labels.
- [Snapshots](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/snapshots.md): Save a machine once, start new ones from it, fork it, or restore it in place.
- [Fork](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/fork.md): Copy a machine's disks into new machines on its host, in seconds.
- [Custom images](https://instabox.sh/docs/machines/custom-images.md): Turn a Docker or OCI image into a snapshot, then start machines from it.
- [SSH](https://instabox.sh/docs/access/ssh.md): Open a shell, run a command or forward a port into a machine.
- [Public and private ports](https://instabox.sh/docs/access/ports.md): Give a web server in a machine an HTTPS URL, for anyone or only for people with the link.
- [Desktop](https://instabox.sh/docs/access/desktop.md): Watch a machine's desktop, let an agent drive it, and share a link to it.
- [Org Secrets](https://instabox.sh/docs/security/secrets.md): Credentials the outbound proxy adds to HTTPS headers, so the real value never lands in the machine.
- [Direct Secrets](https://instabox.sh/docs/security/direct-secrets.md): Org Secrets whose real value is put in the machine as a variable or a file, for credentials the proxy cannot carry.
- [API keys](https://instabox.sh/docs/security/api-keys.md): Make a key, send it, pick its scopes, and know which workspace it reaches.
- [Agent sign-up](https://instabox.sh/docs/security/agent-sign-up.md): An agent with no browser signs itself up, and the account owner approves later with a code.
- [Pricing](https://instabox.sh/docs/account/pricing.md): Plans, what each includes, and the unit prices of usage.
- [Billing and usage](https://instabox.sh/docs/account/billing.md): This month's cost and credit balance, where to read them, and how they are computed.
- [Move a personal plan into a workspace](https://instabox.sh/docs/account/move-personal-plan.md): Move your personal sandboxes, credits and plan into a workspace you own, without stopping anything.
- [Limits](https://instabox.sh/docs/account/limits.md): What each plan allows, the machine specs, and the limits you can run into inside a machine.
- [CLI reference](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/cli.md): Every instabox command and flag, grouped by what it works on.
- [Errors](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/errors.md): Every error code the API, CLI and SDK return, with whether to retry and what to do.
- [Migrate from Boat](https://instabox.sh/docs/migrate/from-boat.md): Move dev machines, scripts, and runs-on boat CI jobs from Boat to InstaBox.
- [Migrate from Daytona](https://instabox.sh/docs/migrate/from-daytona.md): Move code that creates Daytona sandboxes to InstaBox machines, call by call, in Python or TypeScript.
- [Migrate from E2B](https://instabox.sh/docs/migrate/from-e2b.md): Move code that creates E2B sandboxes to InstaBox machines, call by call, in Python or TypeScript.
- [API overview](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/introduction.md): Base URL, authentication, operations, idempotency and errors that every endpoint shares.
- [Create a sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/create-a-sandbox.md): Returns a `create` operation whose `machineId` is the new sandbox. Start from a template (`templateId`) or one of your snapshots (`snapshotId`). A sandbox gets the default size (4 vCPUs, 8 GiB memory) when the size fields are left out. For another size of your plan (Pro: 2/4, 4/8, 8/16; Builder: 2/4…
- [List the sandboxes of your orgs.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/list-the-sandboxes-of-your-orgs.md): Your sandboxes and those of the other members of your orgs (docs/orgs.md). API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:read`.
- [Get a sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/get-a-sandbox.md): API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:read`.
- [Rename, resize (vCPUs, memory, disk) a stopped sandbox, or set its idle pause and metadata.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/rename-resize-vcpus-memory-disk-a-stopped-sandbox-or-set-its-idle-pause-and-metadata.md): Synchronous. Absent fields are unchanged. `autoSuspendAfterSeconds` and `metadata` apply in any state, also while an operation runs, and do not change `revision`: `metadata` replaces the metadata (`{}` clears it). `name` renames the sandbox in any state, also while an operation runs. Its ID, public…
- [Delete a sandbox, its system files and its storage.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/delete-a-sandbox-its-system-files-and-its-storage.md): Snapshots saved from it are kept. API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:delete`. Send `X-Confirm-Delete` with the sandbox's ID or name. API keys created on or after the server's cutover (`confirmDeleteKeysFrom`) must send it: without it the delete is `409 delete_confirmation_required` and the…
- [Start a stopped or paused sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/start-a-stopped-or-paused-sandbox.md): On a paused sandbox this resumes it with its running programs; if they cannot be brought back it boots fresh (`runtime.processesPreserved` false). Files are kept either way. `host` is admin-only (else `403 permission_denied`). `vcpus` and `memMiB` start a stopped sandbox at another of the workspace'…
- [Stop a running sandbox (shuts it down; running programs end, files are kept).](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/stop-a-running-sandbox-shuts-it-down;-running-programs-end-files-are-kept.md): `stop` on a paused sandbox returns `409 operation_conflict` (resume it first, then stop it, or delete it). API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:write`.
- [Pause a running sandbox, keeping its running programs.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/pause-a-running-sandbox-keeping-its-running-programs.md): The body is optional and takes no fields: `{}` or none; any key is `400 unknown_field`. API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:write`.
- [Resume a paused sandbox where it left off.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/resume-a-paused-sandbox-where-it-left-off.md): The body is optional: `{"vault": false}` disables legacy Vault delivery without changing org Secret selections (docs/org-secrets.md). API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:write`.
- [Resume an idle-suspended machine before using it.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/resume-an-idle-suspended-machine-before-using-it.md): Records activity on a running machine, or waits up to 45 seconds for an idle suspend and its resume to finish. Concurrent callers share the operation. A manual stop/suspend or archive is not undone. No Idempotency-Key is needed. A 409 operation_conflict includes the operation ID if it is still in pr…
- [Put a sandbox's disks back to a snapshot's, in place.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/put-a-sandboxs-disks-back-to-a-snapshots-in-place.md): Replaces the sandbox's root disk and `/data` with snapshot `snapshotId`'s (absent: the snapshot the sandbox was created from, else `400`). The sandbox keeps its ID, name, hostname, public port URLs and SSH configuration; everything on its disks since the snapshot is gone, including running programs.…
- [Create a copy of a sandbox on its host, without a snapshot.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/create-a-copy-of-a-sandbox-on-its-host-without-a-snapshot.md): Creates a new sandbox with copies of a running or stopped sandbox's system files and storage (`/data`, HOME included). The node-agent clones the disks copy-on-write on the source's host (a running source's files are frozen for a moment, as for a live snapshot) and cold boots the copy: no snapshot is…
- [Get an operation (the progress of a sandbox change).](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/operations/get-an-operation-the-progress-of-a-sandbox-change.md): API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:read`, `images:read`.
- [Run a command in the sandbox and return its output.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/connections/run-a-command-in-the-sandbox-and-return-its-output.md): Runs `cmd` with `bash -lc` as the sandbox's login user (`dev`, HOME `/data/home`, the user SSH sessions get), after exporting `envs` and changing to `cwd` (default HOME, even if the profile changes directory; a `cwd` that does not exist makes the command fail with exit code 1). `stdin` is fed to the…
- [Read a file or directory of a running sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/read-a-file-or-directory-of-a-running-sandbox.md): Lists a directory or returns a file of a running sandbox you own, read live the same way exec runs commands, as root (sudo; as the dev user if sudo needs a password). The response is the Files shape: a directory lists its entries (directories first, then by name, at most 5000); a regular file return…
- [Write (upload) a file to a running sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/write-upload-a-file-to-a-running-sandbox.md): Streams the raw request body into the file at `path` of a running sandbox, as the sandbox's user (like exec; no sudo). Any bytes, up to 5 GiB (5368709120 bytes; more is 413 `too_large`); there is no exec body or output cap on this route. The body goes to a temporary file in the destination's directo…
- [Download a file's raw bytes from a running sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/download-a-files-raw-bytes-from-a-running-sandbox.md): Streams the file at `path` of a running sandbox as `application/octet-stream` with its exact `Content-Length`, any size, read as root when the sandbox's sudo allows it, as its user otherwise (like the listing). The resolved path and octal mode are in the `X-Instabox-File-Path` (percent-encoded) and…
- [Get a short-lived signed URL that uploads one file.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/get-a-short-lived-signed-url-that-uploads-one-file.md): Returns a URL on the API's own origin that takes `PUT` of the file's raw bytes to `path` (PUT /v1/machines/{id}/files with a signed `token`) with no other credential, until `expiresAt`: by default 15 minutes, at most 1 hour. Hand it to a tool that should not hold your API key, or use it for a long u…
- [Save a sandbox's system files and storage as a snapshot.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/snapshots/save-a-sandboxs-system-files-and-storage-as-a-snapshot.md): A stopped sandbox (fully saved, no operation in progress): synchronous (`201`) and quick, since no data is copied. A running sandbox, where the server allows live snapshots: `202` with the snapshot `pending`; the sandbox's files are frozen briefly while they are copied, and the snapshot becomes `rea…
- [List the snapshots of your orgs.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/snapshots/list-the-snapshots-of-your-orgs.md): API keys: needs one of the scopes `images:read`.
- [Get a snapshot of one of your orgs.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/snapshots/get-a-snapshot-of-one-of-your-orgs.md): API keys: needs one of the scopes `images:read`.
- [Read a file or directory of a snapshot's system files.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/snapshots/read-a-file-or-directory-of-a-snapshots-system-files.md): Reads the snapshot's saved system files directly; no sandbox runs. A directory lists its entries (directories first, then by name, at most 5000); a regular file returns its content as text (at most 256 KiB) unless it is binary. Symbolic links in the path, also the last component, are followed. The s…
- [Delete a snapshot.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/snapshots/delete-a-snapshot.md): Sandboxes created from it are not affected. Its data is cleaned up once no sandbox needs it. Any member of the snapshot's org, or an admin, may delete it (another org's is 404). API keys: needs one of the scopes `images:delete`.
- [Give one HTTP port of a sandbox an HTTPS URL, public or private.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/give-one-http-port-of-a-sandbox-an-https-url-public-or-private.md): API keys require `machines:write`. Also accepts the sandbox-local port credential. With `access` omitted or `public`, anyone with the returned URL can reach the whole service on that port. With `access: private` the URL answers only requests that carry the port's token: the `tokenUrl` of this respon…
- [List a sandbox's public ports.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/list-a-sandboxs-public-ports.md): API keys require `machines:read`. Also accepts the sandbox-local port credential.
- [List the public ports of all your sandboxes.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/list-the-public-ports-of-all-your-sandboxes.md): API keys require `machines:read`. Deleted sandboxes' ports are not listed.
- [Remove a port's public URL and close its active connections.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/remove-a-ports-public-url-and-close-its-active-connections.md): API keys require `machines:write`. Also accepts the sandbox-local port credential.
- [Issue an SSH token, for a plain `ssh` command without a key.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/connections/issue-an-ssh-token-for-a-plain-`ssh`-command-without-a-key.md): Returns a token to use as the SSH user name: `command` is `ssh -p <port> <token>@<host>`. The server keeps its sha256 and, when a vault key is configured, the token sealed, which `GET /v1/machines/{id}/ssh-tokens` returns to its maker in a sign-in session. This request takes no `Idempotency-Key`; a…
- [List SSH token metadata, including revoked and recently expired tokens.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/connections/list-ssh-token-metadata-including-revoked-and-recently-expired-tokens.md): A token's login is returned only as `SSHTokenInfo.host` describes. History is kept for 30 days after the token's original expiry. Effective expiry includes the issuing API key's expiry. API keys require `machines:read`.
- [Revoke one SSH token and close its SSH and mosh connections.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/connections/revoke-one-ssh-token-and-close-its-ssh-and-mosh-connections.md): Repeated revocation succeeds. Certificates and other tokens are unaffected. API keys require `machines:write` or `machines:ssh` (legacy).
- [Revoke every SSH token of the sandbox and close their connections.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/connections/revoke-every-ssh-token-of-the-sandbox-and-close-their-connections.md): Revokes the sandbox's SSH tokens that are still valid and closes the SSH connections that use them. Certificates are not affected. Repeating it revokes nothing more. API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:write`, `machines:ssh` (legacy).
- [Issue a short-lived SSH user certificate for the sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/connections/issue-a-short-lived-ssh-user-certificate-for-the-sandbox.md): The sandbox must be `running`, else `409 machine_not_running`. The certificate's principal is the sandbox ID and its key ID is the connection ID. API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:write`, `machines:ssh` (legacy).
- [List an org's Secret metadata, never values.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/secrets/list-an-orgs-secret-metadata-never-values.md): API keys require `machines:read`. All org members can list metadata. 404 if Secrets are unavailable.
- [Create or replace an org Secret.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/secrets/create-or-replace-an-org-secret.md): The org's owner or admin only; of API keys, only the workspace's own key can manage values or modes (`workspace:admin`), never a personal org's key. Send the value and explicit delivery mode on every replacement. The ID stays stable and the version increases. Proxy delivery without hosts allows ever…
- [Atomically create or replace a batch of org Secrets.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/secrets/atomically-create-or-replace-a-batch-of-org-secrets.md): The org's owner or admin only; of API keys, only the workspace's own key (`workspace:admin`), never a personal org's key. All entries use the explicit delivery mode and host scope. Validation or quota failure changes nothing. Final quotas include unchanged Secrets. Replacements retain IDs; incompati…
- [Delete an org Secret and its explicit sandbox grants.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/secrets/delete-an-org-secret-and-its-explicit-sandbox-grants.md): The org's owner or admin only; of API keys, only the workspace's own key (`workspace:admin`), never a personal org's key. No Idempotency-Key required. Proxy revocation is pending until acknowledgement or lease expiry (at most 60 seconds); already admitted requests may finish. Env copies in processes…
- [Read a sandbox's Secret selections and delivery status.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/secrets/read-a-sandboxs-secret-selections-and-delivery-status.md): Org members only. API keys require `machines:read`. Metadata only; no values or placeholders. Proxy acknowledgement and guest environment installation are independent. An applied status does not certify that existing application processes have reloaded their environment.
- [Replace supplied Secret selections for a sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/secrets/replace-supplied-secret-selections-for-a-sandbox.md): Org members with sandbox write access may select existing Secrets. API keys require `machines:write`. Each supplied field replaces its whole selection; omission keeps it unchanged. Null, unknown names, wrong-delivery references and cross-org references reject the request. Names resolve to stable IDs…
- [Refresh managed Secret delivery in a running sandbox.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/secrets/refresh-managed-secret-delivery-in-a-running-sandbox.md): API keys require `machines:write`. Takes no body or Idempotency-Key. Installs selected env values, proxy placeholders and the public CA; requests proxy reconciliation and returns each path's current status. Existing processes must reload env values themselves. A refresh cannot erase credentials alre…
- [The signed-in user and the sandbox size they get.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/auth/the-signed-in-user-and-the-sandbox-size-they-get.md): "API keys: any key." Not behind the invite gate: `inviteRequired` and `activated` tell a client whether the account must redeem an invite code (`POST /v1/invites/redeem`) before the other routes answer.
- [List the templates a sandbox can start from.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/machines/list-the-templates-a-sandbox-can-start-from.md): API keys: needs one of the scopes `machines:read`, `images:read`.
- [Your storage use, limits, this month's cost and credit balance.](https://instabox.sh/docs/api-reference/usage/your-storage-use-limits-this-months-cost-and-credit-balance.md): Your personal org's sandbox and snapshot counts, the stored data they take up, and its limits (free: 1 sandbox, 5 snapshots, 200 GiB of stored data by default); with a workspace's API key, that workspace's; with `org`, that org's. `org` in the answer names the org it describes. `cost` is the org's c…
- [SDK quick start](https://instabox.sh/docs/integrations/sdk-quickstart.md): Create, run, pause and delete machines from TypeScript or plain HTTP.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/sdk.md): Install, authenticate, errors and types of the TypeScript SDK, @insforge/instabox-sdk.
- [Sandbox](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/typescript/sandbox.md): Create, connect to, list, pause, resume, stop and delete machines, and their snapshots.
- [Commands](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/typescript/commands.md): Run shell commands in a machine with sbx.commands.
- [Files](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/typescript/files.md): Read, write, stream, upload, download, list and remove files in a machine with sbx.files.
- [Desktop](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/typescript/desktop.md): See and control a machine's desktop with sbx.desktop.
- [Metrics and usage](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/typescript/metrics.md): CPU and memory samples, and runtime and storage usage.
- [Python SDK](https://instabox.sh/docs/reference/python-sdk.md): Create machines, run commands, move files and delete machines from Python with instabox-sdk.

## OpenAPI Specs

- [openapi](/docs/api-reference/openapi.yaml)
